description: One online receipt block. For each form the sample counted there, the share in each status group with its 95% margin. Also the nearest blocks either side that hold cases, and the newest status changes the sample saw, as counts. Send the block, never a whole receipt number. Example: {"block":"IOE09366"}.

block.description: IOE and five digits: the first eight characters of an online receipt number. Example: IOE09366.

name: get_receipt_block

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: One receipt block: each form's share in each status group with its margin, the blocks either side, and the newest moves the sample saw.

after.description: The nearest later block where the sample holds cases, or null.

before.description: The nearest earlier block where the sample holds cases, or null.

block.description: The block: IOE and five digits.

forms.description: Each form the sample counted in the block, most counted first.

items.description: One form's figures: how many cases the sample counted and the share in each status group.

counted.description: Cases of this form the sample counted here.

additionalProperties.description: One status group's figure: the sampled count, the estimated share and its 95% margin.

count.description: Sampled cases in this status group.

estimated.description: The sample's estimate of how many of the form's cases here are in this group.

high.description: The high end of the 95% margin on that share, from 0 to 1.

low.description: The low end of the 95% margin on that share, from 0 to 1.

share.description: The estimated share of the form's cases here in this group, from 0 to 1.

groups.description: By status group: approved, denied, withdrawn, closed, revoked, rfe (USCIS asked for more evidence) and waiting (still pending).

items.description: Sampled cases in the block that changed status on one day, counted by form and new group.

cases.description: Sampled cases that made this move on this day.

day.description: The day the sample saw the change, as YYYY-MM-DD.

form.description: The form of the cases that changed.

movedTo.description: The status group the cases moved to: one of the seven groups, or rejected, decided or other.

recentMoves.description: The newest status changes the sample saw in the block, as counts. No receipt number is ever listed. Null when they couldn't be read.

unreadable.description: The parts of this answer that couldn't be read just now, by field name. Each is null in this answer. An empty list means every part was read.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get one USCIS receipt block
